<title level="1" pfs="">[Soniphak](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3269)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Often mistaken for drakes, soniphaks glide above rocky or barren ground, picking out prey with their hearing. A hunting soniphak disables its targets with concentrated bursts of sound before snatching them up and feasting on the move. Despite being able to speak, soniphaks are no more social than other dischorans, generally responding to even the quietest attempts at communication with destructive shouting.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 26

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 24

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 21
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Dischoran_Soniphak.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 9">[Soniphak](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3269)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Huge" />
<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=547" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 141

**Perception** +21; no vision, sensitive echolocation ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 120 feet

**Languages**
[Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +19, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +20, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +17

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +7

**Dex** +6

**Con** +4

**Int** -2

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +1
</row>

Sensitive Echolocation The soniphak can use its hearing as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) with the listed range. If the soniphak takes sonic damage beyond its resistance, its senses are overloaded and all creatures are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) from it for 1 round.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 27 

**Fort** +21 

**Ref** +21 

**Will** +15 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 180

</row>

**Immunities**
[visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727)

**Disruptive Screech** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet of the soniphak uses an [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) action; **Effect** The soniphak makes a screech Strike against the triggering creature. This disrupts a triggering [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) action if the Strike is a critical hit.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, fly 50 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +19 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 3d8+9 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
claw +19 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)),
**Damage** 3d6+9 slashing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
screech +19 ([range 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)),
**Damage** 6d6 sonic plus aftershock

**Aftershock**   Whenever a soniphak hits with a screech Strike, feedback deals each creature the soniphak has [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) 1d6 sonic damage.

**Shattering Scream** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) The soniphak can focus its screech at a stone or rock surface within 60 feet to create an explosion in a 15-foot burst from the point of impact. Creatures in the area take 5d6 piercing damage (DC 28 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save), and the area becomes [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453) due to fragments of loose stone.

**Snatch**   The soniphak can [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=2312) at half Speed with a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in its claws, carrying that creature along with it.

</column>
